plain_text:
BSD Finance & Facilities Committee Meeting Minutes 
Tuesday, November 3, 2026 at 5:00 PM 
Hunt Middle School - Library 1364 North Avenue 
Commissioners Present: Kendra Sowers, Lucia Campriello, Gary Golden, Heather Amato, Clare Wool 
Staff Present: Executive Direction of Finance and Operations, Nathan Lavery 
Guests: None 
 
 
1. Opening  
1.1 Call meeting to order 
5:02pm  
1.2 Suspend Robert's Rules 
 
2. Public Comment 
None 
 
3. Discussion  
3.1 Board Budget Guidance 
Reviewed items to be included in the guidance. The board wants to keep it high level until 
we get more information (like the Dec tax letter from the State) to see if we need more 
detailed guidance. This is a working draft guidance and we can add to it as we know more 
details.  
The Board would like to highlight new programs and investments to show high quality 
instruction. Investing in high quality materials, staff, and supports to achieve student 
outcomes. 
The board wants to fund our strategic priorities in our strategic plan.  
The board would definitely like to invest in the maintenance of our buildings particularly 
around our BHS/BTC building. 
The board would like the 3 different budget scenarios again this year.  
3.2 School Board Member Compensation 
Reviewed draft procedure. Compensation will start at the beginning of a commissioner’s 
term and be paid quarterly. Human Resources will collect tax and bank information to get 
this set up. Paid $500 quarterly, $2000 yearly. Will be retroactive from April 2026.  
3.3 Budget Update 
RISE allocations and the Equitable Budgeting model will be used again for this budget. 
Health insurance: Good news from VEHI. Looks like it will be a lot lower than the 11% as 
Page 1 of 2
Draft
originally budgeted. Now it looks to be on average 2.5% rather than in the double digits. 
This lower percentage could save us about a million dollars. Reserves have also been built 
up.  
Enrollment continues to decline which means less money from the state.  
The state tax letter will be sent out on Dec. 1 with tax estimates so we don’t have that yet. 
We will have a more detailed budget discussion during the Board Meeting tonight. 
Next month we will see some budget scenarios (maybe Dec 15).  
3.4 Bid Approvals - Equipment 
On the consent agenda today, but the bids are more unusual and costly so Dir. Lavery 
wanted to discuss it at the committee level.   Maintenance equipment: need this to 
properly maintain the new high school. Used a company to do a public bid process.  
Even if we award the bid, the district might not decide to buy but lease instead.  
Raised questions about privacy with the robotic cleaning systems.  
Minivans: 2 different items. Jason Reed got a grant for using vans to and from tech center 
and schools. The other vans are used and we need to find ones that are available now.  
These items will be paid as part of the soft costs for the BHS/BTC project. Committee 
agreed to these bids.  
3.5 NESCEC Enrollment & Facilities Study 
The board was provided a copy of this study this week. Shows current capacity of each 
school and current enrollment.  
Looks at housing trends and provides an analysis of housing trends and children coming 
to the district.   
Provides potential options to consider. 
 
4. Adjournment 
6:00pm
